Ticket.Title: Storyboard the 15-second teaser for the scheduling rework
Ticket.Description: Break a 15-second teaser into shots: one shot per idea, each with a duration, a visual description, and the on-screen text. Local generation only, no stock footage, 1080x1920 vertical. Land the direction and the execution spec under media/specs/ so the dependent worker has something to execute.

Comments.Author: approval-gatekeeper
Comments.Body: The storyboard needs sign-off before any frame is generated.
